svg.aria-label: AI Colleagues platform: A platform that hires AI employees instead of coding them. Each AI employee gets a work identity, a mailbox, a human manager, a versioned job description and a strict list of what it may touch. Adding a new one is a configuration step, not new software.

g.text: A platform that hires AI employees instead of coding them. Each
AI employee gets a work identity, a mailbox, a human manager,
a versioned job description and a strict list of what it may touch.
Adding a new one is a configuration step, not new software.
Seven-layer architecture; a gateway enforces permissions,
approvals, quotas and redaction outside the model.
